name: spacejanitor
description: Cross-platform workstation janitor for storage, orphan work, trash, true memory footprint, and OS-blocker forensics.

scripts.desktop:typecheck: npm --workspace @spacejanitor/ui run typecheck && npm --workspace @spacejanitor/desktop run typecheck
scripts.desktop:build: npm --workspace @spacejanitor/ui run build && npm --workspace @spacejanitor/desktop run build
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm --workspace @spacejanitor/desktop run pack
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm --workspace @spacejanitor/desktop run dist
